projects.title: Bioinformatics and Parallel Computing (Capstone)
projects.description:
Researched and designed CUDA-based parallel computing application to generate phylogenetic trees using Maximum Likelihood Estimation algorithm. This program was designed to run on a HPC GPU cluster. Using pre-aligned DNA sequences from multiple organisms, the purpose of this program was to provide biologists important information about potential evolutionary relationships at the nucleotide level.

Technologies: C++, CUDA

projects.title: Smart Dashboard for Electric Go-Kart (EVT)
projects.description:
Researched and developed dashboard prototype using an embedded system to monitor and record track data and vehicle performance for the electric go-kart designed to race in the EV-Grand Prix. This system was capable of reading CAN BUS signals from both the vehicle’s motor controller and battery management signal and had the potential to track GPS and accelerometer data to monitor and track vehicle performance in real-time. This system also was to serve as the vehicle’s dashboard in order to provide basic information such as speed and pack voltage as well as potentially fatal errors to the driver.

Technologies: Bash, Python, SQLite, Raspberry Pi 3B+/Zero W, Raspbian, CAN BUS

organizations.name: Kennesaw State University Electric Vehicles Team
organizations.description:
Developed and integrated data acquisition tools to capture relevant track data for tuning all electric vehicles. Leveraged AI to implement autonomous electric vehicles.

Vehicles included go-karts competing in the evGrand Prix, a formula race car competing in the Formula SAE electric division, and more.
